systemTitle: Department of Consumer Affairs (DoCA) Legal Metrology Rules Knowledge Base

mandatoryDeclarations.title: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Identity and Address
mandatoryDeclarations.description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer must be clearly declared on every package.
examples: Manufactured by: GreenCare Pvt. Ltd., Plot 14, MIDC, Mumbai - 400093

mandatoryDeclarations.title: Common or Generic Product Name
mandatoryDeclarations.description: The generic or common name of the commodity contained in the package must be prominently declared.

mandatoryDeclarations.title: Net Quantity in Standard SI Metric Units
mandatoryDeclarations.description: Net quantity declared in metric SI units using legal symbols (g, kg, ml, l, L, m, N). Illegal symbols like gms, ltr, nos are strictly prohibited.

mandatoryDeclarations.title: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
mandatoryDeclarations.description: Month and year in which the commodity is manufactured, packed, or imported (MM/YYYY or Month YYYY format).

mandatoryDeclarations.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) with Inclusive Tax Phrase
mandatoryDeclarations.description: Maximum Retail Price in Indian Rupees (₹ or Rs.) inclusive of all taxes. Tax inclusion phrase 'incl. of all taxes' or 'inclusive of all taxes' is mandatory.

mandatoryDeclarations.title: Unit Sale Price (USP)
mandatoryDeclarations.description: Unit sale price declared in Rupees per gram/ml/piece for commodities exceeding 1g or 1ml to facilitate price comparison.

mandatoryDeclarations.title: Consumer Care Grievance Redressal Contact Details
mandatoryDeclarations.description: Name, complete address, telephone number, and email address of the person or officer who can be contacted in case of consumer complaints.
examples: Consumer Care: Manager, GreenCare, Toll-Free: 1800-111-2233, Email: care@greencare.in

mandatoryDeclarations.title: Country of Origin (for Imported Commodities)
mandatoryDeclarations.description: Name of the country of origin where the product was produced or manufactured.

specialIndustryProvisions.requirement: Size in cm or standard international size code (S, M, L, XL) along with chest/waist measurement.
All Rule 6(1) declarations must be displayed digitally on the e-commerce product detail page prior to purchase.
Net quantity must be declared by volume in litres/ml along with mass in kg/g at standard packing temperature.

firstOffence.description: Fine up to ₹25,000 for manufacturing, packing, importing, or selling non-compliant commodities.

secondOffence.description: Fine up to ₹50,000 for second offence.

subsequentOffence.description: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year, or both.
